defects.cause: Routing, extraction and generic modeling serialized content-block wrappers as engineering JSON; undefined content could throw TypeError.
defects.fix: Shared provider-text reader excludes reasoning/image blocks and produces a controlled empty-output diagnostic.

defects.cause: The graph invalidated committed results before input/precondition validation, and failed empty candidates could clear artifacts.
defects.fix: Invalidation belongs to accepted draft/model commits and reserved solver requests. Failed pending rebuilds archive prior runs; rejected uncommitted candidates preserve current results.

defects.cause: A prior equilibrium goal overrode a newly explicit solver scope/method/provider.
defects.fix: Explicit current selections take precedence; explicitly incompatible equilibrium requests remain rejected.

defects.cause: Malformed optional choices prevented delivering a valid clarification question.
defects.fix: Reuse the existing choice normalizer; preserve the nonempty question and record an optional-choice diagnostic.

defects.cause: A valid review action was rejected when the other optional action list was empty.
defects.fix: Require at least one action across the two lists. Permission/selection empty-list semantics are unchanged.

defects.cause: Generic/explicit model validation required density for elastic analysis even when self-weight was disabled; draft controls were applied after validation.
defects.fix: Apply confirmed controls first. Require density when needed; reject invalid supplied values; dynamic mass validation remains independent.

defects.cause: A real provider supplied both xM=5 and nodeRole=midspan on a 10m beam; the equilibrium projection rejected the otherwise consistent location.
defects.fix: Resolve supported point labels and check agreement with numeric position. Conflicts, unknown roles and point labels on line loads still fail.

defects.cause: A real clarification supplied gravity direction, but old loads[0].direction issues and invalid-field flags survived; the agent repeatedly extracted parameters and then failed to build.
defects.fix: Clear explicitly corrected load-field diagnostics using existing load identity, not patch array offsets. Preserve unrelated issues and newly reported invalid fields.

defects.cause: The draft normalizer required both IDs for every supplied role, rejecting partial or empty optional assignments before saving other extracted data.
defects.fix: Draft assignments allow partial fields and merge accepted IDs per role. Empty optional entries are omitted; formal template resolution still rejects ambiguous or unknown physical assignments.
defects.evidenceLimit: The rejected nested response was not persisted; the runtime logged INVALID_TEMPLATE_ASSIGNMENTS. Deterministic tests reproduce partial-draft rejection and verify execution guards; the exact rejected key layout is not asserted.

beforeFix.note: All failed attempts are retained. The first registry probe also had a test-only message-ID assertion issue; corrected probe isolates the actual empty-list rejection. A new integration fixture initially omitted required material/section labels and was corrected without weakening validation.

initialBackend.note: Superseded run: one 5-second subprocess timeout under concurrent load, an incomplete new fixture, a legacy eager-invalidation expectation, and newly added tests against previously loaded compiled modules. No tolerances/time limits were relaxed.

liveInitial.note: Two genuine product failures found by the real provider were fixed and rerun; this initial run is not reported as passing.

livePostLocation.note: Both force-only languages and partial delivery passed. The two-turn case emitted INVALID_TEMPLATE_ASSIGNMENTS; it was stopped before further automatic retries and rerun after fixing the draft contract.

browser.note: Live-provider cases are explicitly opt-in and tested separately. Real OpenSees, persistence, reports, WebGL, editing/undo, bilingual runtime controls and three injected rejected operations are exercised; only the LLM transport is scripted.

liveCoverage.note: Initial 6 passing cases, 3 post-location passing cases and the final two-turn passing case cover all eight live test cases. Two original requests are intentionally repeated. Failed and interrupted attempts remain in the evidence; this is not one uninterrupted all-green eight-case batch.

limits: This is product boundary and representative workflow acceptance, not certification of arbitrary natural-language requests or all 300 planned scenarios.
Commercial adapter contract tests are included; this task did not rerun installed commercial SDK acceptance or modify the independent YJK API.
Real provider latency remains measured in minutes; no latency improvement is claimed.
